parameters.name: num_nodes
parameters.description: Number of nodes in the directed communication network

parameters.name: bandwidth_matrix
parameters.description: Available direct bandwidth matrix for ordered node pairs

parameters.name: optional_cost_matrix
parameters.description: Optional link-cost matrix for ordered node pairs, not used in the stated objective

variables.name: route_path
variables.description: Ordered simple path of visited node indices from source to sink including the mandatory service node

variables.name: link_selection
variables.description: Binary link-selection matrix indicating whether direct link (i,j) is used in the chosen route

constraints.name: binary_link_selection
constraints.description: Link-selection variables x are binary decision variables

constraints.name: nonnegative_bottleneck
constraints.description: Bottleneck bandwidth z must be nonnegative

constraints.name: positive_bandwidth_links_only
constraints.description: A direct link may be selected only when its available bandwidth is positive

constraints.name: simple_path_no_repeated_nodes
constraints.description: The chosen route must be a simple path, so each node appears at most once in the ordered route representation

constraints.name: start_at_source_end_at_sink
constraints.description: The route must start at source node s and end at sink node t

constraints.name: must_include_mandatory_node
constraints.description: The route must include mandatory service node m at least once

constraints.name: route_uses_only_available_links
constraints.description: If consecutive nodes appear in the route, the corresponding selected link must be used and must have positive bandwidth

constraints.name: maximize_bottleneck_route
constraints.description: The bottleneck bandwidth is bounded above by the bandwidth of every selected link on the route

constraints.name: static_single_stage_horizon
constraints.description: The planning horizon is a single static stage

constraints.name: bandwidths_nonnegative
constraints.description: All bandwidth values b are nonnegative

objectives.name: maximize_bottleneck_bandwidth
objectives.description: Maximize the route bottleneck bandwidth z for a simple directed route from source node s to sink node t that must pass through mandatory service node m

objectives.name: find_any_optimal_route
objectives.description: Return any feasible simple route achieving the maximum bottleneck bandwidth when multiple routes tie for the best value

final_objective.description: Maximize the bottleneck bandwidth of the selected simple directed route from source node s to sink node t that must pass through mandatory service node m. The tie-handling request 'find any optimal route' does not introduce a second optimization criterion.
